justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Developmental gains in motor, language, and cognitive domains; long-term school readiness outcomes supported.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: State-specific credential; variable requirements; typically 1-3 days training plus documentation.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any PT/OT/SLP working in early intervention; high within-setting applicability, narrow setting scope.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Early intervention funded through Part C IDEA as state-funded entitlement; certification required for provider enrollment and billing.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Required for billing in Part C programs; strong employer demand in state-funded early intervention settings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Family empowerment through coaching model is highly valued; parents report reduced stress.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: EI is dominated by Part C state-funded programs; near-zero direct cash-pay market.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Reimbursement rates are state-mandated and typically low; almost no pricing leverage.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: State credentials are common among pediatric providers; modest differentiation.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: EI contracting agencies do scale with multiple credentialed clinicians, though margins are thin.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Parents access EI through referrals, not by shopping providers; low consumer-facing demand.
justifications.business.efficiency: State-specific coursework is generally achievable in weeks to months.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Valued in pediatric PT/OT/SLP faculty tracks; meaningful but not a board specialty.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Active research base in early childhood intervention, family-centered care, and developmental outcomes.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly relevant to pediatric coursework across all three disciplines.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong evidence supporting early intervention efficacy for developmental delays.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Commonly preferred for pediatric faculty positions, especially in programs with peds clinical tracks.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Modest time/cost burden with solid academic credibility in peds tracks.
